name: OpenHelm Public API
description: Drive OpenHelm Cloud from your own product, server-to-server. Author jobs (reusable task templates whose prompts carry {{placeholders}}), then run them with parameters and read back a structured, schema-shaped result asynchronously — with evidence (screenshot + matched text), a confidence level, and usage/cost. Task-execution failures return 200 with a structured failure_reason; HTTP 4xx/5xx is reserved for request, auth, and quota errors.
